items.title: The Fidelis Partnership announces plans for Singapore reinsurance expansion
items.summary: The Fidelis Partnership plans to launch a new Lloyd's service company in Singapore to handle treaty reinsurance.

items.title: AllianceBernstein appoints Sharon Duah as European ETF specialist
items.summary: Sharon Duah joins AllianceBernstein from Citi to drive the firm's exchange-traded fund strategy across Europe.

items.title: T. Rowe Price appoints Davide Costa as senior ETF specialist
items.summary: T. Rowe Price has appointed Davide Costa as a senior ETF specialist to expand its European footprint.

items.title: Nick Train describes rising AI adoption as bullish for UK equity portfolio
items.summary: Portfolio manager Nick Train has stated that falling costs for AI are positive for his fund following an October return.

items.title: Akur8 launches pricing automation tools for actuarial workflows
items.summary: Akur8 has introduced AI-powered pricing agents designed to handle repeatable tasks while keeping actuaries in control of final modeling decisions.

items.title: FCA brings ESG ratings providers under regulatory scope with 2028 deadline
items.summary: The Financial Conduct Authority has published its final policy statement requiring ESG ratings providers to obtain authorisation to operate in the UK.
